notes.general_comments: There was a good understanding of the characteristics of living organisms, the function of the xylem and white blood cells, asexual reproduction and the description of the term gene. There was some uncertainty about mitochondria , rate of diffusion, osmosis , assimilation and germination. Candidates need to careful ly read the question and be methodical when applying concepts to experiments , for example Question s 8 , 9 and 10 .
